¡En @Ayesa crecemos juntos! 🚀 ✨

Cada profesional de nuestra empresa es importante para nosotros, nos ayudan a crecer de manera diversa y gracias a ellos somos más de 12.000 personas trabajando con el mismo objetivo en más de 40 países.

Si eres una persona entusiasta, te apasiona la #tecnología y buscas un nuevo reto profesional ¡Este es tu sitio!

Buscamos ampliar nuestro equipo con un/a Desarrollador/a Backend PL-SQL para incorporarse en nuestras oficinas de 📍Madrid en modalidad híbrida.

¡Anímate a dar el salto!¡Te estamos esperando!

¿Qué vas a hacer?
• Desarrollo y mantenimiento PL/SQL

¿Qué buscamos?
• Experiencia en el mantenimiento de aplicaciones
• Al menos 4 años de experiencia en desarrollos backend bajo tecnología PL/SQL, Java 8, y BBDD Oracle
• Conocimientos en metodología Agile.

¿Dónde vas a trabajar?
• En nuestras de oficinas de Madrid
• Formato: Híbrido, presencial y teletrabajo. 4 días de teletrabajo - 1 día de presencialidad
• Horario: L a J: 8:00 a 18:00h; V... 8:00 a 14:30h

Ofrecemos un camino lleno de aventuras:

🔹 ¡Llega hasta donde tú quieras! Crece con nuestros programas de desarrollo! Te ayudaremos a marcar tu itinerario de futuro anualmente participando en proyectos vanguardistas con los mejores profesionales del sector.

🔹 Porque lo importante sois tú y los tuyos : contamos con políticas que facilitan la conciliación entre la vida profesional y personal: Flexibilidad horaria, Smart Job y jornada intensiva en verano.

🔹 Tú decides cómo usar tu dinero: disfruta de nuestra retribución flexible, contamos con: Seguro médico, Ticket Restaurant, Guardería y Transporte.

🔹 Plan Bienestar descuentos en viajes, tecnología, formación, deporte, belleza y ¡muchos más.

🔹 Diviértete participando en los diferentes concursos y actividades que organizamos: ¿te gusta el deporte, escribir, la fotografía? Todo tiene cabida.

🔹¡Actualízate! apostamos por un aprendizaje continuo, contamos con formación especializada, certificaciones e idiomas.

🔹¡Deja tu huella! Impacta con nuestros proyectos de voluntariado social.

¡Únete a la multinacional española tecnológica referente en el mundo! 💫🌎

Atendiendo a la Ley Orgánica 3/2007, de 22 de marzo, Ayesa Advanced Technologies se ha marcado como objetivo promover la defensa y aplicación efectiva del principio de igualdad entre hombres y mujeres, evitando cualquier tipo de discriminación laboral por razón de sexo, garantizando así las mismas oportunidades de ingreso

jobs_results.title: Back End Developer
jobs_results.description:
Who is DEKRA? Since its foundation in 1925, the DEKRA promise has been to ensure the safety of human interaction with technology and the environment. The company currently employs around 52,000 people in more than 60 countries on all five continents. With qualified and independent expert services, they provide safety on the road, at work and at home.

We have a clear and ambitious vision of the future. The vision for our 100th birthday in 2025 is to see DEKRA as the global partner for a safe world.

On this ocassion, an exciting opportunity has arisen in our DIGITAL & PRODUCT SOLUTIONS Division. This area is to focus on tech competencies and drive digital innovation to help leading DEKRA into a successful future.

You want to know more? Here we go!

Role position:

We are currently looking for a Backend Developer to strengthen our Big Data Team.

About Big Data Team:

DEKRA offers value to companies through technology, with solid, innovative, flexible and efficient IT products and... services, focused on the digitization needs of companies, providing improvements in their business and decision-making processes. The Big Data & Analytics solutions are based on specialized methodologies and software tools that enable the collection, analysis, and selection of large amounts of data, transforming it into useful information for management processes, decision making, new service development, and business opportunity identification.

Requirements:
• Experience with REST APIs and WebServices.
• Solid hands on working with Spring Framework (Security, MVC, SpringData, Spring Boot and Spring Cloud).
• Experience with Microservices.
• Comfortable using SQL (experience with NoSQL databases is a plus).

Additional Requirements:
• GIT and Maven experience.
• Knowledge of JIRA.

Desirable:
• Knowledge of containers (Docker, Kubernetes…).
• Messaging with Kafka/RabbitMQ.

Profile:
• Bachelor Degree in Computer Science or similar.
• Deep Knowledge in Object Oriented Programming and developing with Java applications.
• Written and spoken English and Spanish.
• Customer-focused attitude.

Benefits include:
• Flexible and dynamic working environment.
• Hybrid role position: Possibility to 3 remote days each week after trial period. Besides, flexible arrival and lunch time.
• Opportunities for continuous learning and upskilling.
• Flexible retribution with possibility of private health insurance, restaurant and kindergarten vouchers.
• Permanent contract in a multinational with a long history.
• Joining a multicultural team where you will feel like a member from day one.
• Help you drive towards your goals.

What is the location of the position?
• Málaga, Madrid or Barcelona (hybrid mode).

Let's consider that we have an interesting project and we want you to be part of it. Don't hesitate, join our team

jobs_results.title: Backend Developer
jobs_results.description:
About Qbeast

Qbeast is a spin-off of the Barcelona Supercomputing Center (BSC) with an innovative approach to Big Data by providing great insights while accessing only the minimum quantity of data. We provide the necessary infrastructure and tools for companies to ingest, transform and analyze large amounts of data in seconds.

We are an international team based in Barcelona. We have successfully raised a significant amount of investments that allow us to comfortably fund our research and development efforts, ensuring the best experience for our customers.

We provide a hybrid remote work model and offer flexible working hours.

The Opportunity

We are currently seeking an individual to join our team and work on our newly developed Universal Storage Engine (USE) product. This role will involve tasks related to our critical storage engine format designed for data lakehouse. You will collaborate closely with the rest of the team to implement unique features that are not currently... available in the market.

As a key piece of our tech team, you’ll be doing:
• Maintaining and adding new features to our storage engine format (Java/Scala and some parts in Rust)
• Updating and maintaining our regression benchmark process to test performance and stability
• Boost our observability features to include more plots, metrics and possibly alerts
• Implement support for other open table formats (Iceberg for example)
• Overall product quality including continuous perf evaluation
• Other things of your interest, we’re a startup so there is lot to be done

To Be Part Of The Team, We Require
• A minimum of five years of professional experience
• Bachelor of Computer Science or equivalent degree
• Strong knowledge of data structure and I/O operations
• Experience running Spark in production
• English proficient at work
• Willing to come to the office for 2 days a week
• Organized, autonomous, and proactive
• Willing to keep learning, sharing knowledge with others
• A great team player, helping others when needed

Our tech stack
• We are developing a revolutionary technology that will power data analytics for different processing frameworks, starting with Apache Spark
• Our infrastructure is managed with Kubernetes, Terraform, and GitHub
• We deliver a full-stack platform built on Typescript, Rust, Java, Scala, and Python

Benefits
• Market conditions according to your background and experience
• Nice office in Barcelona on the Eixample neighbourhood
• Flexible Compensation (transportation, restaurant, kindergarten)
• Health insurance with Adeslas

Our Commitment
• The good things of a startup: we are building a work culture, not only revolutionary software
• You will work with talented, nice people
• The best coffee you will find
• Qbeast will be a company of reference in Data Engineering
• We are always learning about tech and business

If you share our dream of changing the world of Big Data, we must meet soon!

Spin-off of the Barcelona Supercomputing Center

• We are developing a revolutionary technology that will power data analytics for different processing frameworks, starting with Apache Spark
• Our infrastructure is managed with Kubernetes, Terraform, and GitHub
• We deliver a full-stack platform built on Typescript, Rust, Java, Scala, and Python

Benefits
• Market conditions according to your background and experience
• Nice office in Barcelona on the Eixample neighbourhood
• Flexible Compensation (transportation, restaurant, kindergarten)
• Health insurance with Adeslas

Our Commitment
• The good things of a startup: we are building a work culture, not only revolutionary software
• You will work with talented, nice people
• The best coffee you will find
• Qbeast will be a company of reference in Data Engineering
• We are always learning about tech and business

If you share our dream of changing the world of Big Data, we must meet soon!
